comments: 3971cbba: Extract parents facility, discharge date & disposition.
75b6f265: Retrieve patient's discharge date if present.
c1dfe959: Get current date/time in FileMan internal format.
514bf937: If patient's status contains appointment status, process appointment.

830eb231: Check if the document status is 'INCOMPLETE'. If so, calculate the number of days since the document was created and store it in DGJTDL. Call the DAYS routine if the document status is 'INCOMPLETE'.
7fd11e82: Check if the document status is 'DICTATED'. If so, set DGJTFLAG to 1 and call the DAYS routine.

34ccf893: Check if the document status is 'TRANSCRIBED'. If so, calculate the number of days since the document was transcribed. If the current date is not before the transcription date, set DGJTFLAG to 1 and call the DAYS routine.

f7bc5aff: If the document is deletable, check if the document status is 'SIGNED'. If so, calculate the number of days since the document was signed. If the current date is not before the signed date, set DGJTFLAG to 1 and call the DAYS routine.
7729c9c8: ;Get the number of days between the current date/time and January 1, 1841 (the M internal date base)
